data.intro: You should not need a spreadsheet, a GPS vest and a volunteer with a second phone just to remember what happened in your weekly game. Pitchside uses suitable match footage as the source for supported football stats. Record the game, upload it after full-time and review the match, personal stats and leaderboards returned through the app.
data.llmDescription: Pitchside is a football stats app for amateur players that uses suitable match footage as the source for supported statistics. Its launch experience includes Match Stats & Highlights, Personal Stats and Leaderboards on the Free plan, while Personal Clips are Paid. The beta is testing goals, assists, saves, passes and tackles, not GPS distance, sprint or workload measurements.
data.metaDescription: Build a football record from phone-recorded matches. Get Match Stats & Highlights, Personal Stats and leaderboards for 5-a-side, 6-a-side and 7-a-side.
data.aeoQuickAnswer: A football stats app records and organises match and player contributions. Pitchside uses suitable phone-recorded footage as the source for supported goals, assists, saves, passes and tackles, connecting numbers to the match behind them. Free includes Match Stats & Highlights, Leaderboards, Personal Stats and one monthly recording; Paid adds Personal Clips and weekly recording.

contentBlocks.content: Start with the player record
A useful football stats app should answer more than “who scored?”
It should show which match produced the number, keep the footage close to the event and make it possible to compare one performance with the next.
At launch, Pitchside's stats experience is organised around:
Match Stats & Highlights
The game-level record. It connects supported match information with the moments Pitchside identifies in the footage.
Personal Stats
The player's own record across available matches. A number is more trustworthy when you can trace it back to the game behind it.
Leaderboards
A simple way to compare contributions across the players and matches included in the app.
Personal Clips
A Paid feature that collects individual player moments separately from the Free Match Stats & Highlights experience.
Which football stats are being tested?

The private beta is testing event identification around goals, assists, saves, passes and tackles. The final launch list must be taken from Product Status, because supported events can change during testing.
Do not confuse event statistics with wearable data.
Pitchside's approved launch plan is on the left. It does not currently promise distance, sprint or workload measurements. Read the honest comparison in tracking football stats without a GPS vest.
The best football stats app is the one your group keeps using
There are three common ways to track an amateur match.
Enter every event live
This can be accurate when a dedicated person watches and records the whole game. It also gives that person a job every week.
Add the numbers from memory
Fast, familiar and usually followed by an argument about the assist.
Use the recording as the source
This is the Pitchside approach. The footage provides evidence that can be reviewed instead of relying only on memory or live data entry.
No method removes judgement completely. A tackle, assist or player assignment can still need review. Pitchside should make that uncertainty visible.
See the number and the moment behind it
Stats without context can be misleading. Video without organisation is hard to use.
Pitchside brings them together. A supported event can lead back to the recording, while a clip carries the match and player context behind it.
For the review workflow, visit football video analysis. For the clip experience, see AI football highlights.
Designed for the football that rarely gets counted
5-a-side
Lots of shots, saves and quick changes of possession. A compact pitch can work with one clear phone angle, although two phones may improve goal-area detail.
6-a-side and 7-a-side
More space and clearer roles make it useful to keep contributions connected across several matches. Two phones may provide stronger coverage on a wider pitch.
Goalkeepers
Goals are remembered. Saves are often not. Pitchside's beta is testing how goalkeeper events and clips can be included in the same player record.
The weekly group
Leaderboards and Personal Stats matter most when the same group returns. The value grows from the record, not one isolated result.
What affects the result
Pitchside works from what the camera can see.

items: A stable, elevated landscape recording provides a clearer view.
Players need to remain visible enough for supported identification.
Similar kits, low light and crowded areas can cause errors.
One phone may cover a compact pitch; two are preferred where the far end becomes difficult to read.
Statistics should be reviewed before they are treated as final.

contentBlocks.content: Learn the setup on record football matches.
Start manually today
The automatic app is in private beta. The free 5-a-side football stats tracker is available now if your group wants to log goals, assists, saves and other match events manually.
Use the manual tracker for the current match. Join the launch list if you want the recording to do more of the work later.
Stats are included on the Free plan
Free: Match Stats & Highlights, Leaderboards, Personal Stats and one recording per month.
Paid: Everything in Free, Personal Clips and one recording per week. £4.99 weekly, £12.99 monthly or £99 annually.
Build a football record worth opening next week
Pitchside currently focuses on 5-a-side, 6-a-side and 7-a-side phone footage. Join the launch list for access and release updates.

tldrPoints: Pitchside uses suitable match footage instead of relying only on live entry or memory.
The launch record includes Match Stats & Highlights, Personal Stats and Leaderboards.
The beta is testing goals, assists, saves, passes and tackles.
Pitchside does not currently promise GPS distance, speed, sprint or workload data.
Personal Stats are Free; Personal Clips and weekly recording are Paid.

faqs.answer: A footage-based system can identify the events it has been trained and tested to support. Results still depend on camera position, visibility and the limits of the current model. Pitchside is in private beta and does not claim perfect automatic statistics.
faqs.question: Can a football stats app track a match automatically?
Are Personal Stats free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Personal Stats are included in the planned Free launch tier, together with Match Stats & Highlights, Leaderboards and one recording per month.

faqs.question: Are Personal Clips free?
faqs.answer: No. Personal Clips are listed as a Paid launch feature. Free users still receive Match Stats & Highlights within their recording allowance.

faqs.question: Does Pitchside replace a GPS vest?
faqs.answer: Not for physical-load data. A GPS vest is designed for distance, speed and workload. Pitchside focuses on supported football events, match output and highlights from video.

“Football” and “soccer” describe the same sport in different markets. Pitchside's current product and pricing copy is UK-led, while the underlying small-sided use case also applies to players who search for a soccer stats app.
